watches.name: QUADTEC | Shifting Time
watches.description: When Quadtec was launched in 2006 in Las Vegas at the JCK watch & jewelry show it was a sensation from the get go. Way before smart watches were invented quadtec was the first real smart watch - not to say really a smartwatch like none of its kind ever before. Minutes would rotate around the center hour in quarter increments showing passed minutes on the right and remaining minutes counting down to the next hour on the left side. Digital time - Analog motion. Three modes to display the time were programmed into the modul. EF - for elapsed forward time, ES - for segmented time, and EU for unified time. "Shifting Time". Additionally it has a fifty-year perpetual calendar ( a first in this technology), alarm feature and backlight function. Good till 2056. 316L stainless steel case, mineral crystal, 10-year Lithium battery, WR50M. The master set has three bands to select from according to your mood and look you need to portray. Image displays 14 minutes before 8.
